_comment: ELEVEN registrations, not nine hooks. gotcha-guard.mjs and rule-guard.mjs are each registered TWICE, against
different matchers (Edit|Write and Bash), because it guards two different hazard
classes. A verification phrased as 'all four hooks fire' counts it once and would
pass green while the Bash matcher silently stopped firing — the same shape as the
doc-authority defect this plugin exists to have fixed. Count registrations.
THE SERVED PLUGIN IS NOW THE WORKING TREE (2026-10-17). Until then it was a copy,
found 2026-08-28: Claude Code copied the marketplace into
~/.claude/plugins/cache/<mkt>/<plugin>/<version>/ and served THAT, so editing
propagate/hooks/*.mjs changed nothing until `claude plugin update propagate@tathya`
ran and the session restarted (the running gotcha-guard.mjs was a week-old snapshot
while both manifests said 0.2.0). Now the repo is its own directory marketplace
(`propagate@propagate`) and loads in place: an edit here applies on `/reload-plugins`
or the next session start, with no update step. That also means a HALF-FINISHED hook
edit is live: finish hook edits behind the test gate before any reload (GOTCHAS G80).
The version bump still matters for the manifests that must agree, not for delivery.
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is resolved by Claude Code to this plugin's root, so these
paths survive the plugin being installed anywhere. The previous arrangement
hardcoded $HOME/.claude/hooks and $HOME/.claude/skills/propagate.
rule-guard, added 2026-08-28. The matcher is Agent|Task|ExitPlanMode and NOT
Bash|Edit|Write, because today exactly one rule declares a trigger and it is
about subagent dispatch. Widen this the moment a rule declares a trigger for
another tool — a matcher narrower than the rule set is a rule that loads and
can never fire.
Verified live 2026-08-28 that PreToolUse DOES fire on Agent and that an omitted
`model` is visible as an absent key, using a Bash control in the same config so
'does not fire' was distinguishable from 'config never reloaded'.
dispatch-model, added 2026-11-13 (#265, #214 part 2), is the second registration in this
group and shares its matcher: it ignores ExitPlanMode itself. It refuses a dispatch whose
model differs from its issue's Model field (read from the snapshot `day open` writes, no
GraphQL read) unless the prompt carries `model_reason:`, and on an allow moves a Backlog or
Ready item to In progress. It fails open on its own bugs, saying so.
plan-goal, added 2026-11-13 (#244 goal clause, G3), is the third registration in this group and
also shares its matcher: it acts only on ExitPlanMode. It denies a plan that names no active
goal (`Goal: G<n>`) and carries no `goal_reason:` line, and logs each approval to
$PROPAGATE_STATE_DIR/plans/approvals.jsonl for `goals check`. Blind reads allow, saying so.
rule-guard on Bash, added 2026-11-13 for rule:deploy-to-the-environment-the-check-needs, the first rule whose
trigger is a shell command (`vercel --prod`). The owner chose option (b): register on Bash with an `if` condition,
so rule-guard runs only for commands mentioning vercel and not on every shell command (measured 208-323 ms each).
Widen the `if` the moment another rule declares a Bash trigger, or the new trigger loads and can never fire.
Verified live after /reload-plugins: see the commit that added this.
agent-guard, added 2026-11-12 (#251). Denies writes to propagate's READ-ONLY subagents
(edge-settler, doc-curator, adversarial-reviewer), keyed on the payload's agent_type. Plugin
agents cannot carry their own hooks or permissionMode (docs), so this is the only enforcement.
Silent and allowing for the main session and every other agent.
subagent-cost, added 2026-11-06 (#188). Appends one row per finished lane to
$PROPAGATE_STATE_DIR/costs/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl, summing the subagent transcript's usage
by type. SubagentStop's payload carries no tokens, and the completion report's
figure is the final request only (measured on #188). Fails open and silent: exit 0,
no stdout, errors to costs/errors.log.
agent-nudge, added 2026-11-12 (#251). After a `settle --json` listing 3+ edges,
adds one line telling the MAIN session to dispatch propagate:edge-settler and gate it with
`settle --check`. Informs only; silent inside subagents.
